text: Norway's $2.3T sovereign wealth fund recorded a Q3 loss of 278B kroner ($29.7B). Fixed income returned -3.5%, while equities gained 0.5%. Bonds comprise just over 25% of assets, with 70% of fixed income allocated to sovereign debts. Energy equities outperformed utilities and real estate.

meta.note: Asset-class returns differ; the reported portfolio loss is an aggregate accounting measure.

text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang identified working capital and European energy availability as constraints on neocloud capacity. Nvidia has committed nearly $10B to European AI initiatives. Nebius fell 3.6% premarket, CoreWeave 4%, and Iren and Applied Digital nearly 4%.

meta.note: Demand and capital scarcity are executive-reported conditions; aggregate capacity and financing gaps are unquantified.

text: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield fell over 17 bps to 4.972%, its lowest since Sept. 23 and largest daily decline since March 2023. The 2-year yield dropped over 16 bps to 4.659%, while the 30-year fell over 14 bps to 5.296%. Oil prices rose as equities declined.

meta.note: Cross-maturity yield declines are observable; investor allocation flows are not quantified.

text: OpenAI is negotiating a funding round of up to $30B at a $1.25T pre-money valuation, led by UAE investors and Coatue. The company is also negotiating additional UAE computing capacity. A confidential IPO filing is reported, while the financing amount, investor commitments, and listing date remain unfinalized.

meta.note: Valuation and financing terms are reported but not finalized; no completed capital transfer is established.
